def silhouette(grid, cells):
    """Binary mask of the bounding box of the given (row, col) cells: 1 where a cell sits."""
    t, l, b, r = bbox(cells)
    s = set(cells)
    return [[1 if (i, j) in s else 0 for j in range(l, r+1)] for i in range(t, b+1)]

def xor_crop(grid):
    """Crop of the differences between the silhouettes of the two shapes, as 8s over 0s."""
    cs = components([[1 if v else 0 for v in row] for row in grid], 1)
    m1, m2 = silhouette(grid, cs[0]), silhouette(grid, cs[1])
    h = min(len(m1), len(m2)); w = min(len(m1[0]), len(m2[0]))
    d = [[m1[i][j] ^ m2[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if any(d[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if any(d[i][j] for i in range(h))]
    if not rows: return [[0]]
    t, b, l, r = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
